intents.title: Stop corrupting the not-to-be-confused terms
intents.statement: parse_term_sections strips the leading '- **' before slicing rest[2..idx], so every confused-with term loses its first two characters. Slice from the start of rest instead, in all three bullet shapes.

intents.title: Make anchors stable when a title has several delimiters
intents.statement: A single replace("--", "-") pass leaves '&' surrounded by spaces as a double dash, so the 'CI Runner Profile & Cached Acquisition' anchor does not match its table link. Extract one anchor function that collapses dash runs without changing existing underscore anchors.

intents.title: Regenerate the compiled dictionary
intents.statement: After the parser and anchor fixes, run memory sync-terms, prove it is idempotent across two runs, and confirm the three new terms appear with intact text.

intents.title: Make the CLI build again
intents.statement: watcher.rs calls chrono::Utc::now() but afwe-cli does not depend on chrono, so the binary cannot be rebuilt at HEAD and the checked-in afwe.exe predates the last two turns. Use afwe_core::util::now() instead of adding a dependency.

intents.title: Migrate legacy term frontmatter
intents.statement: Four terminology files still use the old term/kind: concept/status: canonical frontmatter, so load_terms ignores them and regeneration silently drops Action Queue, Human Floor, Prompter Delegation and Skipping Resistance. Rewrite their frontmatter to the current schema and add a Meaning section.
